systemStatus.detail:
MON AUG 24, 7:15 AM PT RUN. Sources: Gmail (Toast daily + Toast weekly + Sling + TripAdvisor) and live Chrome reads of Google Ads and Yelp Ads.

1. TOAST SUN AUG 23 -- ARRIVED. Group email only (6:33 AM); the single-location detail lands ~7:39 AM and will backfill tomorrow. Net $4,564.12, gross $4,673.55, 144 orders, 202 guests, avg order $31.70, avg per guest $22.59. vs the prior Sunday Aug 16: net -22.3%, guests -13.7%, avg order -20.7%.

2. THE REAL STORY IS LABOR. Sunday ran 39.8% of net. Saturday was 13.3%. The prior Sunday was 25.1%. The full Aug 16-22 week was 20.4%. Derived labor cost approx $1,816.52 on $4,564.12 net. Sunday was staffed with 11 employees / 13 shifts / 55.50 hours and did a quarter of Saturday's volume. Julianna Ornelas was auto-clocked out again (also happened Saturday) -- that is two days running and it inflates hours. ACTION: pull Sunday's punch detail and check the auto-clockout.

3. TOAST WEEKLY AUG 16-22 -- NEW, and it independently confirms Saturday a third time at $16,721.45. Week net $46,209.56 (+17.9% vs prior week) on guests -4.8%. The entire gain is check size, not traffic: avg check $42.83 (+21.7%). Saturday alone was 36% of the week's net. Voids +78.7% to $883.25 across 81 items. Toast forecasts $35,472.72 for Aug 24-30 (-23.2%).

4. SLING MON AUG 24 -- ARRIVED (7:00 AM). 6 employees, 6 shifts, 25.50 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime. Roughly half of Sunday's hours, which reads as a correction. 1 Cook, 1 Barista, 2 Bartenders, 2 Servers. SINGLE-COOK COVERAGE for a second straight day.

5. GOOGLE ADS -- LIVE READ. Yesterday: 349 impressions (+61), 11 clicks, $9.27 (-$12.44), $0.84 CPC. Conversions still calculating, so 0.00 is not final. Last 7 days: 3,138 impressions, 124 clicks, $179.46, 41 conversions. Only 1 of 4 campaigns serves. Both PMax campaigns are paused with all asset groups limited by policy -- one of them (Local store visits PMax-2) delivered 1,455 impressions and 7 conversions in the last 7 days and now delivers nothing. Effective budget $15/day vs $104.17/day configured. 2 drafts unpublished. ACTION: the policy limitation on the PMax asset groups is the highest-leverage ad fix available.

6. YELP -- LIVE READ, clean session. 30 days: ~40k ad impressions, 361 ad clicks, 440 page visits from ads (57% of 772), 105 leads from ads (66% of 158). Billing Aug 1-23: $314.13 spend, $1.10 CPC, $3.78 cost-per-lead -- best CPL on record. Audience size still reads 'Limited'. Bonus budget still not surfaced (third run). Unified Ad Settings panel again failed to load. Inbox stuck at 15 unread for 48h.

7. TRIPADVISOR -- nothing in 48h.

8. NOT RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN: reviews, reservations, business profile, payroll. Carried from the 4:00 AM run. Donald Clay's 1-star food-safety allegation is 17 days unanswered.
